policy.purpose: Assign every strategic gap an evidence source, accountable role, cadence and success contract before it can influence portfolio progress.
policy.secrets_policy: Collector records may store metadata and immutable references only; never credentials, provider payloads, financial records or personal data.

collectors.action: Verify the current public dashboard timestamp, source commit, content deploy, immutable receipt and visible strategic scoreboards as one exact snapshot.
collectors.success_contract: Emit live_verified evidence only when timestamp, source, receipt, deploy and visible-surface equality are all proven.
collectors.missing_proof: Post-merge content deploy, immutable matching receipt and independent public timestamp/UI verification.

collectors.action: Prove Google owner login, server allowlist, durable admin change or upload, public visibility and order handoff in production.
collectors.success_contract: Owner and non-owner auth matrix plus fresh-session persistence and customer-visible outcome are proven without exposing credentials.
collectors.missing_proof: Authenticated owner access and production Google provider evidence.

collectors.action: Prove signed owner production identity, migration parity and timestamped current provider balances in one reconciliation run.
collectors.success_contract: Historical totals, current balances and zero synthetic adjustments are independently reported with bounded timestamps.
collectors.missing_proof: Authorized origin, owner session and provider-balance access.

collectors.action: Choose retained reference, bounded migration source or read-only retirement and document parity plus rollback.
collectors.success_contract: One owner-confirmed transition state with preservation boundaries, acceptance evidence and rollback.

collectors.action: Complete a reversible Firebase preview cutover proving login, durable saved progress, logout and restoration before production.
collectors.success_contract: Provider, domain and environment readiness plus authenticated preview journey and rollback are proven.
collectors.missing_proof: Firebase project, provider, authorized-domain and environment access.

collectors.action: Run a complete product, live and conversion audit and establish the first bounded inquiry or booking metric.
collectors.success_contract: Current journey evidence and one named KPI with owner, unit and measurement window are persisted.
collectors.missing_proof: Current production journey and inquiry or booking measurement source.

collectors.action: Rebuild the Prompt Router and independent Code Copilot path from current main, then prove one approved end-to-end production delivery.
collectors.success_contract: Fresh-main PR, green current suite, preview proof and submit-to-visible-result delivery evidence are complete.
collectors.missing_proof: Fresh-main implementation, current CI and live bridge delivery.

collectors.action: Instrument qualified interest to conversation to confirmed registration across active Toronto programs.
collectors.success_contract: A privacy-safe aggregate funnel has metric names, units, bounded windows, owner and weekly cadence.
collectors.missing_proof: Observed registration source and agreed privacy-safe aggregation path.

collectors.action: Validate collector ownership, cadence, coverage, freshness and action selection on every strategic run.
collectors.success_contract: Every active project and System Intelligence has a valid collector and exactly three non-healthy actions are selected deterministically.
collectors.missing_proof: Merged implementation and mandatory CI evidence.

collectors.action: Prove canonical source and live state, then choose coexistence, bounded migration, read-only archive or retirement.
collectors.success_contract: Owner-confirmed role, data-preservation plan, source-to-live mapping and rollback are recorded.
collectors.missing_proof: Canonical source mapping and owner governance decision.

collectors.action: Measure retries, time-to-proof, reopened work and evidence rejection without storing prompts or private payloads.
collectors.success_contract: Privacy-safe aggregate counters have definitions, units, bounded windows and a daily cadence.
collectors.missing_proof: Stable non-content retry and cycle-time counter source.

collectors.action: Register one privacy-safe business outcome source and cadence for every commercial active project.
collectors.success_contract: Commercial projects expose aggregate outcome names, owners, units and bounded windows without personal or financial payloads.
collectors.missing_proof: Observed KPI adapters for commercial projects.
